semantic_scope.note: The supplied render happens to depict an Analyze-like mock, but this artifact is intentionally extracted only as a reusable visual/system reference. Page meaning, flows, states and actions must come from each page semantic contract.

extraction.conflict_note: DESIGN.md describes a light COMMERCIAL AI / Intelligence OS system using Geist + JetBrains Mono, while the supplied render/HTML is a dark External Calc Product Preview using Inter. For this selected visual reference, render and rendered HTML take precedence. Conflicting DESIGN.md metadata is not merged into the visual canon.

identity.reference_name: External Calc — Dark Command Center Reference

visual_principles: clear hierarchy between shell, primary panes, technical nested surfaces and operational data
monospace reserved for machine-like metadata and technical payloads
ambient depth is localized rather than decorative everywhere

typography.technical_mono: Tailwind/default monospace stack in the rendered artifact

usage.numeric_kpi: 24px strong with technical/mono treatment in this reference

typography.conflict_rule: Do not import Geist or JetBrains Mono from DESIGN.md into this selected visual reference unless separately approved.

shape.rule: Use rendered geometry. The conflicting light DESIGN.md describes sharper 4-6px geometry and is not authoritative for this reference.

ambient_background: large low-opacity blue glow near upper center
large low-opacity indigo glow toward right side
32px subtle technical grid with radial mask
depth_and_texture.panel_depth: dark translucent planes, backdrop blur, low-opacity white hairline borders and deep black shadow
depth_and_texture.active_depth: blue selection/action elements may use restrained blue glow
depth_and_texture.success_depth: emerald ready dots may use restrained glow and pulse
depth_and_texture.rule: Glows encode brand/state emphasis and must not become generic decoration.

desktop.composition: persistent left sidebar + flexible main canvas

sidebar.active_nav: blue tint/gradient + blue border/ring + tiny blue state dot
sidebar.inactive_nav: slate-400 + very subtle white hover plane
sidebar.bottom_utility_zone: may host dev/test controls in prototypes; not a production requirement

top_status_bar_pattern.right_region: compact progress chips when a page has a staged flow
top_status_bar_pattern.scope_rule: This is a reusable pattern, not a mandatory global element on every page.

grid.scope_rule: Reference proportions illustrate the language; target pages choose spans through their PAGE_SPEC.

plane_hierarchy: nested technical surface where semantics justify it
dense table/list or contextual review block

section_microheader.pattern: uppercase 10px technical label + optional divider + optional machine namespace

status_badge.success: emerald text + ~15% fill + ~30% border + optional micro-dot

primary_button.effects: restrained blue glow + hover brightness + tiny active scale

metric_block.numeric_treatment: 24px strong; semantic color allowed when meaningful

density_and_hierarchy.container_strategy: few strong panes; nested surfaces only when the information model benefits from a technical sub-plane
density_and_hierarchy.titles: compact semibold title paired with technical micro-labels where appropriate
density_and_hierarchy.actions: one visually dominant CTA per action cluster; secondary controls subdued

observed_in_html: body is column by default and row at md
major grids are single-column until lg, then use 12-column composition
secondary status copy hides on smaller widths
responsive_evidence.limitation: No separate mobile render was supplied. Do not invent a complete mobile design language from this artifact alone.

reuse_rules: Use this JSON as a global visual vocabulary, not as the semantic specification for any one screen.
Each future PAGE_SPEC decides which shell regions, grids and component patterns apply.
Do not copy page-specific labels, counts, steps, entities or actions unless the target page contract requires them.
Do not assume every page uses a top progress bar, 7/5 split, 8/4 split or developer state widget.
Do not classify future pages as Analysis because this mock happens to display Analyze content.
Fidelity means reusing visual grammar, density, hierarchy, tokens, surface logic and component anatomy rather than duplicating mock content.
excluded_from_global_contract: Entrada / Interpretação / Revisão as a universal app flow
developer test-state selector as an end-user component
page-specific grid spans as universal layout requirements
